name: Santa's Little Helper
source:
After an exhausting week of work,  

partying with friends at a winter cabin in the woods sounds like a great idea. 

That is...until your car breaks down and none of your friends are available to help you. 

Luckily, you've found a roadside assistance service not too far away: Santa's Little Helper. 

[From [url=https://digitalmaeri.itch.io/santas-little-helper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一周的疲惫工作后，

与朋友在树林里的冬季小屋聚会听起来是个好主意。

也就是说……直到你的车抛锚并且你的朋友都无法帮助你。

幸运的是，你在不远处找到了路边援助服务：圣诞老人的小帮手。

[来自[url=https://digitalmaeri.itch.io/santas-little-helper]itch.io[/url]]
